cards.title: A scorecard is a versioned group
items: It saves an ordered list of classifier revisions and shared run settings.
Each classifier keeps its own labels, learned head, trigger state, and metrics.

cards.title: Why send one request
items: The target appears once while each classifier context stays under its own scope.
Usage is counted once and the complete request is cached by its full fingerprint.

cards.title: History stays auditable
items: Changing a classifier creates a new classifier revision and an affected scorecard revision.
A run retains the exact scorecard revision and learned checkpoints that produced it.
